#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test script to reproduce and profile evictor_v2 performance."""

import time
import random
from typing import OrderedDict
from vllm.core.evictor_v2 import LRUEvictor, EvictionPolicy

def benchmark_evictor(num_blocks=10000, num_iterations=1000):
    """Benchmark the evictor performance."""
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Pre-populate the evictor with blocks
    for i in range(num_blocks):
        block_id = i
        content_hash = i % 1000
        num_hashed_tokens = random.randint(1, 32)
        last_accessed = float(i)
        evictor.add(block_id, content_hash, num_hashed_tokens, last_accessed)
    
    # Benchmark eviction operations
    start_time = time.time()
    for _ in range(num_iterations):
        evicted_block_id, content_hash = evictor.evict()
    end_time = time.time()
    
    elapsed = end_time - start_time
    print(f"Evicted {num_iterations} blocks in {elapsed:.4f} seconds")
    print(f"Average time per eviction: {elapsed/num_iterations*1000:.4f} ms")
    print(f"Throughput: {num_iterations/elapsed:.2f} evictions/second")
    
    return elapsed

def test_evictor_basic():
    """Test basic functionality of the evictor."""
    print("\n=== Testing Basic Functionality ===")
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Test add
    evictor.add(1, 100, 10, 1.0)
    evictor.add(2, 200, 20, 2.0)
    evictor.add(3, 300, 30, 3.0)
    
    assert 1 in evictor
    assert 2 in evictor
    assert 3 in evictor
    print("✓ Add operations work correctly")
    
    # Test evict
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
    assert block_id == 1
    assert hash_val == 100
    assert 1 not in evictor
    print("✓ Evict operation returns correct block")
    
    # Test update
    evictor.add(4, 400, 40, 1.0)
    evictor.update(4, 5.0)
    assert evictor.free_table[4].last_accessed == 5.0
    print("✓ Update operation works correctly")
    
    # Test remove
    evictor.remove(4)
    assert 4 not in evictor
    print("✓ Remove operation works correctly")

def test_evictor_ordering():
    """Test that eviction respects LRU ordering."""
    print("\n=== Testing LRU Ordering ===")
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Add blocks with same last_accessed but different num_hashed_tokens
    evictor.add(1, 100, 10, 1.0)
    evictor.add(2, 200, 20, 1.0)
    evictor.add(3, 300, 30, 1.0)
    
    # Should evict the one with highest num_hashed_tokens
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
    assert block_id == 3
    print("✓ Eviction selects block with highest num_hashed_tokens when timestamps are equal")

def test_evictor_timestamps():
    """Test that eviction respects timestamp ordering."""
    print("\n=== Testing Timestamp Ordering ===")
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Add blocks with different timestamps
    evictor.add(1, 100, 10, 1.0)
    evictor.add(2, 200, 20, 2.0)
    evictor.add(3, 300, 30, 3.0)
    
    # Should evict the one with lowest timestamp
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
    assert block_id == 1
    print("✓ Eviction selects block with lowest timestamp")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== Evictor V2 Performance Test ===")
    test_evictor_basic()
    test_evictor_ordering()
    test_evictor_timestamps()
    
    print("\n=== Performance Benchmark ===")
    benchmark_evictor(num_blocks=10000, num_iterations=1000)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test script to reproduce and profile evictor_v2 performance."""

import time
import random
from typing import OrderedDict
from vllm.core.evictor_v2 import LRUEvictor, EvictionPolicy

def benchmark_evictor(num_blocks=10000, num_iterations=1000):
    """Benchmark the evictor performance."""
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Pre-populate the evictor with blocks
    for i in range(num_blocks):
        block_id = i
        content_hash = i % 1000
        num_hashed_tokens = random.randint(1, 32)
        last_accessed = float(i)
        evictor.add(block_id, content_hash, num_hashed_tokens, last_accessed)
    
    # Benchmark eviction operations
    start_time = time.time()
    for _ in range(num_iterations):
        evicted_block_id, content_hash = evictor.evict()
    end_time = time.time()
    
    elapsed = end_time - start_time
    print(f"Evicted {num_iterations} blocks in {elapsed:.4f} seconds")
    print(f"Average time per eviction: {elapsed/num_iterations*1000:.4f} ms")
    print(f"Throughput: {num_iterations/elapsed:.2f} evictions/second")
    
    return elapsed

def test_evictor_basic():
    """Test basic functionality of the evictor."""
    print("\n=== Testing Basic Functionality ===")
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Test add
    evictor.add(1, 100, 10, 1.0)
    evictor.add(2, 200, 20, 2.0)
    evictor.add(3, 300, 30, 3.0)
    
    assert 1 in evictor
    assert 2 in evictor
    assert 3 in evictor
    print("✓ Add operations work correctly")
    
    # Test evict
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
    assert block_id == 1
    assert hash_val == 100
    assert 1 not in evictor
    print("✓ Evict operation returns correct block")
    
    # Test update
    evictor.add(4, 400, 40, 1.0)
    evictor.update(4, 5.0)
    assert evictor.free_table[4].last_accessed == 5.0
    print("✓ Update operation works correctly")
    
    # Test remove
    evictor.remove(4)
    assert 4 not in evictor
    print("✓ Remove operation works correctly")

def test_evictor_ordering():
    """Test that eviction respects LRU ordering."""
    print("\n=== Testing LRU Ordering ===")
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Add blocks with same last_accessed but different num_hashed_tokens
    evictor.add(1, 100, 10, 1.0)
    evictor.add(2, 200, 20, 1.0)
    evictor.add(3, 300, 30, 1.0)
    
    # Should evict the one with highest num_hashed_tokens
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
    assert block_id == 3
    print("✓ Eviction selects block with highest num_hashed_tokens when timestamps are equal")

def test_evictor_timestamps():
    """Test that eviction respects timestamp ordering."""
    print("\n=== Testing Timestamp Ordering ===")
    evictor = LRUEvictor()
    
    # Add blocks with different timestamps
    evictor.add(1, 100, 10, 1.0)
    evictor.add(2, 200, 20, 2.0)
    evictor.add(3, 300, 30, 3.0)
    
    # Should evict the one with lowest timestamp
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
    assert block_id == 1
    print("✓ Eviction selects block with lowest timestamp")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== Evictor V2 Performance Test ===")
    test_evictor_basic()
    test_evictor_ordering()
    test_evictor_timestamps()
    
    print("\n=== Performance Benchmark ===")
    benchmark_evictor(num_blocks=10000, num_iterations=1000)

    evictor = LRUEvictor()

    # Should evict the one with highest num_hashed_tokens
    block_id, hash_val = evictor.evict()
